name: mobile-serve
description: Open your project on your real phone, like Go Live: start it or pick a running server, scan a QR code, done.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode the extension won't start or restart dev servers, because that runs scripts from the project's package.json. Plain HTML folders can still be served.

commands.title: Mobile Serve: Stop Sharing on the Network

port.description: The port the dev server is started on for the phone.

scripts.build: npm run bundle && npm run notices && npm run check-bundle
scripts.build:debug: npm run bundle -- --sourcemap && npm run notices && npm run check-bundle
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check && npm test && npm run bundle -- --minify && npm run notices && npm run check-bundle
